## 2. Regulatory Compliance, African NRA Support & Stability Standards
- **Manufacturing Quality**: WHO-GMP certified and ISO 9001:2015 facilities adhering to IP, BP, USP, EP, and ICH Q7 peptide quality standards.
- **Dossiers for Africa & Global Export**: Complete 5-Module ACTD & eCTD dossiers, WHO-Format CoPP, FSC, CRIAM/GS1 serialization options, and bilingual EN/FR/PT/AR labeling for NAFDAC, FDA Ghana, WAHO, PPB, TMDA, NDA, EFDA, SAHPRA, ZAZIBONA, EDA, and DMP.
- **ICH Zone IVb Stability**: Real-time (30°C ± 2°C / 75% RH) and accelerated (40°C ± 2°C / 75% RH) studies backing 24–36 month export shelf life.
- **Peptide Analytical QC**: Batch reverse-phase HPLC purity (>=99.0%), ESI-MS molecular weight confirmation, and 16-section GHS SDS for our lyophilized Peptide APIs, RUO Research Peptides & custom peptide syntheses.

## 3. Commercial Procurement & Export Logistics
- **Minimum Order Quantities**: 1,000 packs (finished formulations); 50 vials (Pharmaceutical Peptide APIs); 10 vials (Research Peptides RUO).
- **Incoterms Supported**: FOB (Nhava Sheva JNPT / Mumbai BOM / Delhi DEL), CIF, CFR, CIP Air, EXW.
